assumptions.details: An overpayment at the start reduces principal from that date. On a payment date, the installment is settled before the overpayment. In the ING model, the next installment is recalculated using accrued interest; in the general model, recalculation applies to the following period. A rate change reprices the first settlement affected by it. Full principal repayment also settles accrued interest on the overpayment date. The general calendar model has an interest-coverage floor. The ING model finds the minimum cent installment that repays the balance and interest by maturity, without a larger final installment. This is not a verified bank algorithm. Interest uses contractual dates; changing collection dates does not change interest. ING normally reduces the installment after overpayment; term reduction requires a separate amendment. [ING loan servicing rules](https://www.ing.pl/indywidualni/kredyty-i-pozyczki/kredyt-hipoteczny/mam-juz-kredyt). Reconciliation with your individual contract remains necessary. Tranches, grace periods, arrears and currency conversion are unsupported.
